tools.name: get_fpl_gameweek_briefing

tools.name: get_fpl_transfer_trends

tools.name: audit_fpl_players

tools.name: get_predicted_lineup

tools.name: get_all_lineups
tools.description: Retrieve the complete slate of all 20 Premier League predicted formations, starting XIs, and confidence scores for the current 2026/27 Gameweek.

tools.name: get_injuries_and_suspensions
tools.description: Retrieve live 2026/27 Premier League injuries, medical return dates, active red/cup bans, and FA 4-yellow-card suspension tightropes.

tools.name: get_set_piece_takers
tools.description: Retrieve verified 1st and 2nd choice penalty, corner, and direct free-kick takers across 2026/27 Premier League clubs.

tools.name: get_fixture_difficulty
tools.description: Rank Premier League clubs from easiest to hardest upcoming Fixture Difficulty Rating (FDR 1-5) ticker.

tools.name: get_table

tools.name: get_fixtures

tools.name: get_clubs
tools.description: List all 20 Premier League or 24 EFL Championship clubs with verified 2026/27 head coaches, stadium names, capacities, primary kit colors, and set-piece specialists.

tools.name: get_match_preview
tools.description: Retrieve pre-match tactical intelligence for an upcoming 2026/27 fixture: predicted formation clash, manager matchup, squad availability, and form guide.

tools.name: get_match_report
tools.description: Retrieve post-match tactical reports with confirmed starting lineups, chronological event timelines (goals, cards, substitutions), xG, and possession stats.

tools.name: get_referees
tools.description: Retrieve 2026/27 PGMOL Select Group 1 Premier League referee statistical dossiers: strictness index, yellow/red cards per match, fouls, and penalty rates.

tools.name: get_transfer_rumours
tools.description: Retrieve live 2026/27 Premier League transfer and managerial rumours graded Tier 1-4 by journalistic reliability.

tools.name: get_bet_builder_stats
tools.description: Retrieve 2026/27 Premier League Bet Builder cheat-sheet stats: Poisson 1+ & 2+ Shot on Target probabilities, player Fouls Committed/90 & 4-YC booking risk, Most Fouled Players (Foul Magnets/90), Team Corners & BTTS rates, and RoboKlopp starter-filtered Data-Backed Bet Builder Angles.

tools.name: get_player_props
tools.description: Retrieve raw 2026/27 API-Sports Pro per-90 player prop telemetry (Shots on Target/90, Total Shots/90, Fouls Committed/90, Fouls Drawn/90, Yellow Cards/90).

tools.name: compare_players
tools.description: Compare two 2026/27 Premier League players head-to-head across FPL pricing/xPts/value, RoboKlopp expected Start %, API-Sports per-90 shooting & foul props, set-piece duties, and multi-pillar verdict.

tools.name: get_uk_tv_schedule
tools.description: Retrieve 2026/27 UK football live TV broadcast channels (Sky Sports, TNT Sports, Amazon Prime Video, BBC iPlayer, ITV) and Saturday 15:00 GMT Article 48 blackout status.

tools.name: get_international_duty
tools.description: Retrieve 2026/27 Premier League senior international call-ups, long-haul air kilometres (South America, Africa, Asia), and Gameweek turnaround recovery hours by club.

tools.name: get_clutch_stats
tools.description: Retrieve 2026/27 Premier League clutch & game-state leaderboards: 85'+ and 90'+ stoppage-time goals, points won from losing positions, points dropped from winning positions, individual super-sub goals, and 1'-15' fast starters.

tools.name: get_club_trophies
tools.description: Retrieve verified all-time or modern-era (post-1992) major trophy honours across 34 English & European clubs, or compare two clubs head-to-head (e.g. 'liverpool-vs-manchester-united').

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_match_report, get_club_trophies · Public sink: get_match_report, get_uk_tv_schedule, get_club_trophies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_match_report, get_club_trophies · Public sink: get_match_report, get_uk_tv_schedule, get_club_trophies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_table" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Retrieve official 2026/27 Premier League or 36-team UEFA Champions League standings." → after: "Retrieve official 2026/27 Premier League, 24-team EFL Championship, 36-team UEFA Champions League, Europa League, Conference League, or UEFA Nations League standings."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
